# SpringConstraint2D

- Inherits [`Constraint2D`](constraint2d.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringConstraint2D")`

Holds two points at a distance, with a spring: a spring, a bungee cord or a suspension. With a `Stiffness` of 0 it is a rigid rod of `Length`, which suits the links of a rope bridge.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Damping` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The damping ratio of the spring. At 0 it oscillates forever; at 1 it settles without overshooting. |
| `Length` | `number` | `2` | read/write | The rest length of the spring, in meters. |
| `MaxLength` | `number` | `1000` | read/write | The longest the spring can be stretched to, in meters. |
| `MinLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The shortest the spring can be compressed to, in meters. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `4` | read/write | How quickly the spring returns to its rest length, as a frequency in hertz. At 0 the joint is rigid. |
